local RenderImage = PluginSet.FGUI.RenderImage

---@class ModelPanel: UIGComponent
---@field m_model FairyGUI.GGraph
local ModelPanel = class("CustomModelPanel", UIGComponent)

function ModelPanel:ctor()
    ModelPanel.super.ctor(self)
    self.m_renderImage = false
    
    self.onAddedToStage:Add(self.OnAdded, self)
    self.onRemovedFromStage:Add(self.OnRemove, self)
end

---GetModelGraph
---@overload
---@return FairyGUI.GGraph
function ModelPanel:GetModelGraph()
    return nil
end

function ModelPanel:OnAdded()
    local graph = self:GetModelGraph()
    if not graph then return end

    ---@type PluginSet.FGUI.RenderImage
    self.m_renderImage = RenderImage.New(graph)
    self.m_renderImage:UnloadModel()
end

function ModelPanel:OnRemove()
    if not self.m_renderImage then return end
    self.m_renderImage:Dispose()
    self.m_renderImage = false
end

---LoadModel
---@param model string|UnityEngine.Object
---@return UnityEngine.Transform
function ModelPanel:LoadModel(model)
    if not self.m_renderImage then return end
    return self.m_renderImage:LoadModel(model)
end

---UnloadModel
function ModelPanel:UnloadModel()
    if not self.m_renderImage then return end
    self.m_renderImage:UnloadModel()
end

---StartRotate
---@param speed number
function ModelPanel:StartRotate(speed)
    if not self.m_renderImage then return end
    self.m_renderImage:StartRotate(speed)
end

---StopRotate
function ModelPanel:StopRotate()
    if not self.m_renderImage then return end
    self.m_renderImage:StopRotate()
end

---SetRotate
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param z number
function ModelPanel:SetRotate(x, y, z)
    if not self.m_renderImage then return end
    self.m_renderImage.modelRoot.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(x, y, z)
end

---Rotate
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param z number
function ModelPanel:Rotate(x, y, z)
    if not self.m_renderImage then return end
    x = x or 0
    y = y or 0
    z = z or 0
    local transform = self.m_renderImage.modelRoot.transform
    local angle = transform.localRotation.eulerAngles
    transform.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(angle.x + x, angle.y + y, angle.z + z)
end


---SetBackGround
---@param image FairyGUI.GImage
---@param image2 FairyGUI.GImage|nil
function ModelPanel:SetBackGround(image, image2)
    if not self.m_renderImage then return end
    self.m_renderImage:SetBackground(image, image2)
end

return ModelPanel
